facts.fact: Mali's Directorate of Pharmacy and Medicines states that the Ministry of Health and Social Development has retained DHIS2 as the national platform for managing health information.
Mali's Directorate of Pharmacy and Medicines reports that on 17-18 November 2026 it restored automatic data migration between DHIS2 and the separate OSPSANTE health-logistics system.
